messages:
Anna: Quick heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `coalesce_kv_batching` to `on` for a 1% canary at 12:00 UTC. This is the batching + KV-prefetch change that reduces duplicate KV reads. Need ops coverage and perf guardrails.

Priya: Can you post the exact flag key + API call? also what perf tests should I run locally?

Anna: Flag key: `ff/coalesce_kv_batching`. Toggle example:```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_API' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/toggles/ff%2Fcoalesce_kv_batching/targets 
  -d '{"audience":"canary","percent":1}'
```Will flip at 12:00 UTC.

Owen: I'll run the perf harness against the canary pool 30m pre and 30m during. Tests: 95th/99th token latency, p50 gen latency, token-per-second throughput, and tail error rate. I’ll post results.

Anna: Guardrails (hard):
- overall error-rate delta <= 0.5% absolute
- p95 token latency increase <= 50ms (relative to baseline)
- p99 spike detection: no >2x short-term jumps
- token throughput regression < 7%
If any threshold trips, rollback immediately.

Mike: I'll take oncall window 12:00–13:30 UTC and watch alerts. @sre-bot please attach the alert query.

sre-bot: Alert queries: (PromQL)```promql
# error rate over requests
(sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_errors[1m])) by (job)) / (sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests[1m])) by (job))

# p95 token latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```Set pager if error-rate delta > 0.5% sustained for 5m.

Priya: For perf validation, I'll run the local perf harness with these inputs: 512-token sequences, mix of cached prefixes (70%) and new (30%). Also run kv-cache stress: 3x concurrent sequences with overlapping prefixes.

Anna: On rollback — two options: flip flag back to 0% or use the rollout API to pause. Rollback curl:```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_API' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/toggles/ff%2Fcoalesce_kv_batching/targets 
  -d '{"audience":"canary","percent":0}'
```Or run: `deploy-bot rollback --flag coalesce_kv_batching --audience canary`

Anna: Also note: this change touches batching window logic (batch_coalesce_ms from 8 -> 6ms in PR). PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4321 — please review.

Owen: quick FYI — I saw a single 503 in staging during a small run:```
2026-06-04T11:42:23Z svc-inference[pid=2345] ERROR RequestHandler: upstream timeout reading kv shard
```Low frequency, but worth watching.

Priya: I’ll run a small synthetic that tries to reproduce the 503 by spamming overlapping keys. If I see >1% error we abort.

Mike: I'll be on pager and will confirm Slack notification channel (#incidents & #eng-platform). Please ping me with the direct link when flip happens.

Anna: plan recap:
- 11:20 UTC: final preflight checks (metrics dashboards up, perf harness queued)
- 11:30 UTC: PR approval / merge if green
- 11:45 UTC: dry-run in staging for 10m
- 12:00 UTC: flip to 1% canary
- 12:00–12:30 UTC: watch metrics, Owen posts perf; if all good scale to 5% at 12:40
- rollback immediately if any guardrail trips

Priya: PR review done, left one tiny comment. LGTM otherwise.

Owen: Perf harness started (link: https://perf.redwood/runs/5678). Posting baseline in ~25m.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: `ff/coalesce_kv_batching` -> canary 1% at 2026-06-04T12:00:00Z by Anna. Run ID: run-20260604-17695

Anna: Thanks all. Please react with :eyes: once you’ve set up your dashboards. I’ll ping at flip time.

Priya: :eyes:

Mike: :thumbsup:

Owen: :eyes:

sre-bot: Monitoring hooks attached to the thread.
